description:
What will it take to build an autonomous AI agent that is safe and simple enough for anyone to use? In this OpenClaw roundtable discussion, creator Peter Steinberger shares his North Star: creating an agent simple enough for his mother to use without technical friction. While OpenClaw remains a platform tailored for power users today, upcoming onboarding improvements and cloud options are bridging the gap.

author: GitHub
description:
The GitHub Universe 2026 badge doubles as a handheld gaming console loaded with retro games. In this quick walkthrough, explore built-in apps like Flappy Mona, Mona Paint, and Mona Pet, plus custom digital badge profiles. Discover how easy it is to add community games from Ashley Wolf’s repository by asking GitHub Copilot for setup help. Watch as we install the classic Microsoft 3D Maze screen saver directly onto the badge hardware. Explore more Universe announcements, hardware hacks, and on-demand sessions at https://githubuniverse.com
